## Opulence — G4 background stallion

**Who he is.** Opulence is a pale ice-blue Earth-pony stallion with a sandy-gold mane, turquoise-green eyes, and a **two-shopping-bags cutie mark**. He first appears among the guests at **Gladmane’s Las Pegasus resort** in *Viva Las Pegasus* (S6E20), then reappears as a background visitor and crowd pony. He is easy to recognize by his blue coat and swept golden forelock.

**Name and speaking status.** “Opulence” is used by the fan-maintained [Friendship Is Magic character index](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Earth_ponies/Stallions) and [Manebooru’s character tag](https://manebooru.art/tags/character-colon-opulence), which aliases “opulence.” I could not verify the name in spoken dialogue, official credits, merchandise, or a creator statement, so its *official* status is unconfirmed. No distinct spoken lines or credited voice actor could be verified. No alter ego or other identity is established.

**Appearances.** Besides *Viva Las Pegasus*, the character index lists *Once Upon a Zeppelin*, *School Daze – Part 1*, *Grannies Gone Wild*, *Friendship University*, *Common Ground*, *Between Dark and Dawn*, *2, 4, 6, Greaaat*, and episode 8 of *Baby Flurry Heart’s Heartfelt Scrapbook*. These are background appearances, not evidence of a speaking role.

**Verified show still.** Opulence is the **blue stallion on the left**, beside Sun Cloche and Princess Cadance in *Once Upon a Zeppelin*. Original animation frame from *My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic*; archived on Twibooru by **Anonymous #9FE6**, who is the *uploader*, not the animation artist.
